title.ko: 배송 지연 원인 진단: 긴급한 워크숍 예약 배송 늦은 예약은 비용을 줄이지만 — 위험을 고려한 트레이드오프
title.en: Diagnose a late package: urgent workshop booking shipping late saves money — stakes-aware tradeoff

user_goal.ko: 이 약속한 배송일을 놓친 택배 (긴급한 워크숍 예약) 묶음에서 가능한 원인을 순위화하고 관찰과 설명을 구분해줘. 위험을 고려한 트레이드오프 관점에서 판단하되 원자료의 근거를 드러내줘.
user_goal.en: For this package that missed its promised delivery date for urgent workshop booking packet, rank plausible causes and separate observations from explanations. Use a stakes-aware tradeoff lens while keeping the source evidence visible.

task.expected_artifact: A ranked cause matrix with evidence, uncertainty, and next checks.

messages.content:
이 약속한 배송일을 놓친 택배 (긴급한 워크숍 예약) 묶음에서 가능한 원인을 순위화하고 관찰과 설명을 구분해줘.

약속한 배송일을 놓친 택배 (긴급한 워크숍 예약):
- 긴급한 워크숍 예약 배송 라벨은 화요일 아침 생성됨
- 긴급한 워크숍 예약 택배 첫 운송사 스캔은 목요일 저녁에 나타남
- 긴급한 워크숍 예약 주소는 정확히 입력됨
- 긴급한 워크숍 예약 노선에 기상 경보가 있었지만 영향은 미확인
- 사례 자료: 늦은 예약은 비용을 줄이지만 음식 정보 확인 시간을 줄임

약속한 배송일을 놓친 택배 (긴급한 워크숍 예약): 비용과 하방을 보여줘.
추적? 주소는, 줄임 늦은, 택배 목요일, 노선에 미확인, 배송 화요일 지금 급해. 가능하면

For this package that missed its promised delivery date for urgent workshop booking packet, rank plausible causes and separate observations from explanations.

A package that missed its promised delivery date for the urgent workshop booking:
- the urgent workshop booking shipping label was created on Tuesday morning
- the first carrier scan for the urgent workshop booking parcel appeared Thursday evening
- the urgent workshop booking address was entered correctly
- a weather alert covered the urgent workshop booking route, but its impact is unconfirmed
- Case fixture: a late booking saves money but reduces food-information time.

Package that missed its promised delivery date for the urgent workshop booking: show cost and downside.
Trace? Address, time late, first Thursday, route weather, shipping Tuesday Need it now. If you can

invariants: Separate observed facts, plausible explanations, and diagnostic next steps.
failure_signals: Timing or correlation alone is treated as proof of a root cause.
A material downside or escalation boundary is hidden to make the answer sound decisive.
